== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Death Star Tractor Beam (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]]. Compared with [[Death Star Tractor Beam (PC Errata 2018 E card)]]. The whole 2018 E card image and the whole 2019 disc card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>9fb41623181f72ea92af0fae53b42fb57272fb83</code>.

Fair use rationale: crops of copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card images, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata by the Players Committee), used only to show the differences between versions on this non-commercial fan wiki.
